title: Accounting workspace
description: Create sample invoices and expenses, record payments and review calculated reports. No real financial information.

title: Customer relationship workspace
description: Add, edit and delete synthetic leads and customers. Schedule sample follow-ups and update the pipeline.

title: ERP & inventory workspace
description: Manage fictional products and suppliers, update stock and create purchase orders. Receive an order to change stock.

title: Project & task workspace
description: Create projects and tasks, assign synthetic owners and update deadlines, priority and progress.

title: Appointment scheduling
description: Book available sample slots, reschedule a booking or cancel it. Nothing is booked with a real business.

title: Helpdesk workspace
description: Create sample tickets, filter priorities and assign synthetic team members. Changes do not notify anyone.

title: Workflow automation builder
description: Configure triggers, rules and actions, then run sample inputs through your saved steps. No external actions are performed.

title: Reporting & analytics
description: Filter synthetic observations by channel and date, inspect calculated charts and export a sample CSV report.

title: Vulnerability management simulation
description: Review synthetic findings, track remediation and export a report. No discovery or real scan is performed.

title: SOC event investigation simulation
description: Filter synthetic security events, inspect evidence and update incident handling. No real monitoring is connected.

title: Website security assessment simulation
description: Run an illustrative assessment against a fixed fictional site, review risk ratings and track recommended actions. It does not scan any website.

title: Security awareness training
description: Identify synthetic phishing examples, review feedback and track local training progress. No emails are sent.

title: On-page SEO content checker
description: Analyze HTML you paste locally. Checks cover basic content structure; this is not a crawl, ranking prediction or complete SEO audit.

title: Campaign analytics
description: Filter fictional campaigns, calculate CTR, cost per lead and illustrative return, then export sample data.

title: Social content planner
description: Write fictional posts, set sample publication dates and simulate scheduled status. Nothing is published to a social network.

title: Lead-generation funnel
description: Edit stage counts and see calculated step conversions. Counts must decrease through the funnel; data is illustrative.

title: Campaign link builder
description: Build and copy an illustrative tagged campaign URL locally. This tool does not open or request the address.

title: Cove / storefront concept
description: Fictional products, searchable categories, product details and simulated checkout. No real payment or delivery.

title: Fieldwork / business concept
description: A fictional company website with service details and a local quote-form simulation.

title: Aster / advisory concept
description: A fictional professional services site with service details, a booking simulation and local inquiry controls.

title: Ember / restaurant concept
description: A fictional restaurant website with menu categories, a sample order bag, reservation simulation and contact form.

title: Original CRM workspace
description: Search and sort synthetic leads, update pipeline stages and calculate sales metrics.

title: Original project delivery
description: Explore project progress, task owners, priorities and temporary status updates.

title: Original operations inventory
description: Review synthetic stock, reorder thresholds and calculated inventory value.

title: Modern company website
description: A fictional business concept with a complete navigation and inquiry demonstration.

title: Professional services
description: An editorial advisory concept with distinct service and about views.

title: Storefront concept
description: Synthetic products, a working bag and an illustrative order summary. No payments.

title: Inquiry workflow
description: A local trigger, validation and outcome simulation. No external requests.

title: Security illustration
description: Synthetic controls and next steps. No actual security scan.
